^4d4dff有一个叫莫罗克的沙漠城镇。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
If you go there, you will find a dog around the oasis.
He is really mysterious and he can speak so don't be suprised.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
如果你去那里，会在绿洲附近发现一只狗。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell the dog ^4d4dffBoya is really great.^000000

[博雅]
告诉那只狗^4d4dff博雅真的很棒。^000000
如果你有任何问题，就问那只狗。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Why are you staring at me?
I had to come up with a password right?

scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你为什么盯着我看？
我不得不想一个密码，对吧？
这个密码有什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Anyway, that place is not far from here so, it is a reasonable place for a beginner like you.
Ok, may Freya bless you~!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
总之，那个地方离这里不远，所以对于像你这样的初学者来说是个合理的地方。
好了，愿弗蕾雅保佑你~！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You need to register to explore the culvert in Prontera at the Knight Guild.
After registering there go to the western gate of Prontera. The manager of the culvert is near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你需要在普隆德拉的骑士公会登记，才能探索普隆德拉的下水道。
登记后，前往普隆德拉的西门。下水道的管理员就在入口附近。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Once you enter the culvert you can find a dispatched cat. Don't be surprised if he talks to you.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
一旦进入下水道，你会发现一只被派遣的猫。如果它跟你说话，请不要感到惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell the cat ^4d4dffBoya's help is like a giant and beautiful tuna^000000.
He is really mysterious and he can speak so don't be suprised.
He will give you a battle target when you tell him that.
If you have any questions ask the cat.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告诉那只猫^4d4dff博雅的帮助就像一条巨大而美丽的金枪鱼。^000000

当你告诉它这句话时，它会给你一个战斗目标。
如果你有任何问题，就问那只猫。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Why are you staring at me like that?
It's just a password that I made up.
scripts.translation:

你为什么那样盯着我看？

scripts.text:

Anyway...
That place is nor far from here so, it is a reasonable place for a beginner like you.

scripts.translation:

总之...
那个地方离这里不远，所以对于像你这样的初学者来说是个合理的地方。
好了，愿弗蕾雅保佑你~！

酷。

前往莫罗克城的西南方。

Let me see...

[Boya]
First take a ship to Byalan Island from Izlude!
There is an underground cave. Go in and get to the bottom floor where you will find a historic underwater city..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
首先从依斯鲁得岛乘船前往拜兰岛！

[Boya]
Although it's underwater, you can breath so don't worry.
There is a dispatched trainee around the entrance of the Ocean City.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
虽然是在水下，但你可以呼吸，所以不用担心。

Ok, may Freya bless you!

kkkkuuuuahhh.

bowwow..

bowwow..

啊...嗯...

If so, should I start securing this oasis more clearly?
Can you see a Condor flying?
scripts.translation:
[会说话的狗]
如果是这样，我应该更彻底地保护这片绿洲吗？

So people can use this oasis safer and more comfortably.
scripts.translation:

你能帮我把它们赶走吗？
这样大家使用这片绿洲时就能更安全、更舒适了。

Krrrr woo bow...

我们要至少猎杀10只秃鹰，好吗？

快去吧快去吧！

They're a really good group.
They accepted a wandering talking dog.
Take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[会说话的狗]
乐园团很酷。
他们真的是个很好的团体。
他们接纳了一只流浪的会说话的狗。
保重，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
Hey look.
I'm a talking dog.
Not a wolf.
I wasn't a dog originally...
scripts.translation:
嘿，看这里。
我是会说话的狗。
不是狼。
我原本并不是狗...

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Anyway are you a Eden Group member?
Oh good to see you.
I am also a member of Eden Group.
Take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[会说话的狗]
不管怎样，你是乐园团的成员吗？
哦，很高兴见到你。
我也是乐园团的成员。
保重，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Why are you looking at me like that?
......
scripts.translation:
[会说话的狗]
你为什么那样看着我？
......

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Meow...
Who are you meow?
Why are you here meow?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
喵...
你是谁喵？
你为什么在这里喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Come on meow...
I may be standing here and talking to you like this meow but I am a still a cat meow...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
拜托喵...
我虽然站在这里和你说话喵，但我仍然是一只猫喵...

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Dear human you are
a member of my group?
Re... really...!
Dear Boya's help is like a giant and...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
亲爱的人类，你是
我团体的成员吗？
真...真的吗...！
亲爱的博雅的帮助就像巨人一样...

scripts.text: Beautiful Saury
scripts.translation: 漂亮的秋刀鱼

scripts.text: Fresh Mackerel
scripts.translation: 新鲜的鲭鱼

scripts.text: Beautiful Tuna
scripts.translation: 漂亮的大金枪鱼

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Big and beautiful Saury...
I am shy.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
又大又漂亮的秋刀鱼...
我有点害羞。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I want to eat mackerel.
Where are the big and fresh mackerel meow?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
我想吃鲭鱼。
又大又新鲜的鲭鱼在哪里喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Do you know the big and beautiful tuna?
Dear Boya sent you here for sure.
How do I explain this...?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你知道又大又漂亮的大金枪鱼吗？
亲爱的博雅一定是派你来的。
该怎么说呢...？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Did something pass under my feet just now meow?
Do you want to kill a cat.
The environment here is terrible.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
刚才有什么东西从我脚下跑过去了喵？
你想杀猫吗？
这里的环境太糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Anyway I'm doing what I was assigned to do.
So hi, hello and welcome.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
不管怎样，我正在执行分配给我的任务。
所以你好，欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Did you come here to have a battle?
Hunt those Thief Bugs, hurry up!
Hunt at least 10!
Meooow!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你是来战斗的吗？
去猎杀那些浮勒盗虫，快点！
至少猎杀10只！
喵呜！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I really don't like those nasty crawlers...
Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
我真的不喜欢那些恶心的爬虫...
喵~！

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThe cat was suprised by
a thief bug and froze in
place. Hunt those
Thief Bugs around here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff那只猫被浮勒盗虫吓到了，
僵在原地。去猎杀
附近的浮勒盗虫。^000000

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now do you understand the dirty and humid underground sewers?
Eeeh look what's next meow.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
现在你明白地下下水道有多脏多潮湿了吗？
哎呀，看看接下来是什么喵。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
It's a symbol of dirt next to those Thief Bugs.
Hunt some Tarou to make the sewers cleaner.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
那是那些浮勒盗虫旁边的脏污象征。
猎杀一些白鼠，让下水道变干净点。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
For our members joining this mission.
Hunt 10 Tarou.
Easy, ain't it?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
对于加入这次任务的成员。
猎杀10只白鼠。
很简单，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Why didn't I ask you at once? kkk..??
Umm........
Because it's just a training mission.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
我为什么没一开始就问你呢？呵呵..??
嗯........
因为这只是一个训练任务。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Training missions are hard and anoying.
So go hurry and hunt 10 Tarou.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
训练任务既困难又麻烦。
所以快去猎杀10只白鼠。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Clean the sewers. Now the first step is hunting Thief Bugs.
Isn't that simple, meow?
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
清理下水道。第一步是猎杀浮勒盗虫。
很简单，对吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Take care to check your map so you don't get lost.
It's a service meeow.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
注意查看地图，别迷路了。
这是服务喵。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Great job~!
How'd you get rid of those dirty bugs and Tarou. You are brave.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
干得好~！
你是怎么除掉那些脏虫和白鼠的。你真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now have courage because I'm sending you to a stronger opponent.
But first in order to test your courage, hunt Familiars.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
现在鼓起勇气，我要派你去面对更强的对手。
但首先，为了测试你的勇气，去猎杀使魔。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Familiars will bite you so be careful.
They are mean.
They scare me so just hunt 5 and that should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
使魔会咬人，所以要小心。
它们很凶的。
它们把我吓坏了，所以只要猎杀5只就够了。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
That will show me that you are brave.
Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
这样就能证明你很勇敢了。
喵~！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I don't have anything...
......
What do you want meow? Familiars are waiting to fight with you, hurry up, move~!
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
我没什么要说的...
......
你想怎么样喵？使魔正等着和你战斗呢，快去吧，动起来~！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
If you can't kill the Tarou you might get all kinds of dirty diseases.
So be proud of yourself and do your best to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
如果你杀不死白鼠，可能会染上各种肮脏的疾病。
所以要为自己感到骄傲，尽全力去消灭它们。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
我会帮点小忙。
看，我恢复了你的力量喵..

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
You are great meow~
You killed them so quickly!
Meow...
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你真棒喵~
你消灭它们的速度好快！
喵...

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now you are not scared of bugs and tarou at all.
Thanks for participating in the Conquer the Culvert training mission.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
现在你完全不怕虫子和白鼠了。
感谢你参加“征服下水道”训练任务。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now go back to the headquarters and ask Instructor Boya to make sure he has the beautiful tuna...
I will be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
现在回到总部，让教官博雅确认他那里有美味的金枪鱼...
我会在这里等着。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Do you know how to get to the Eden Group Headquarters?
Prontera is the closest city from here.
Go to Prontera and find an Eden Group Teleporter.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你知道怎么去乐园团总部吗？
离这里最近的城市是普隆德拉。
去普隆德拉找乐园团的传送员。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Familiars are really scary.
They're always flying.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
使魔真的很可怕。
它们总是在飞。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
It's the last course so cheer up.
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
这是最后一关，加油。
我会帮点小忙。
看，我恢复了你的力量喵..

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
You've completed 'Conquer the Culvert'.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters to report to Boya.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你已完成“征服下水道”。
回到乐园团总部向博雅汇报。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Boya might eat my tuna while he is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
博雅可能会在你等待期间吃掉我的金枪鱼。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
How are you meeow?
Did you volunteer to conquer the Culvert?
You are a member of the Edgen Group for sure.
You are helping to make the world a better place.
scripts.translation:
[胆小的猫]
你好喵？
你是自愿参加“征服下水道”任务的吗？
你肯定是乐园团的成员。
你在帮助让世界变得更美好。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hey, how are you?
Good to see you~
Are you going inside?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嘿，你好吗？
很高兴见到你~
你要进去吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Umm...?
You are not the one I am waiting for.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
嗯...？
你不是我在等的人。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hello?
Since I got a report, I was waiting for you.
You came here to join the training mission, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你好？
因为我收到了报告，所以一直在等你。
你是来参加训练任务的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Have you ever entered this cave before?
I don't know if you already heard some stories in this village.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你以前进过这个洞穴吗？
我不知道你是否已经在村里听到过一些传闻。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There are many of dead souls that change their appearance as if they are real people and make threatening remarks.
It's too bad, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
这里有很多亡魂，它们会伪装成活人并做出威胁性的举动。
真糟糕，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
That's why we chose this place as step 2 of the battle training mission.
This step is called 'Conquer Ghost Cave~'.
Help people to enjoy their nights comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
所以我们选择这里作为战斗训练任务的第二步。
这一步叫做“征服幽灵洞穴~”。
帮助人们安享夜晚。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There are many dangerous things there. Hmm...
To you the 1st floor is enough.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
那里有很多危险的东西。嗯...
对你来说，第一层就足够了。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Lets conquer the dangerous ghost cave...
Kill the bone Skeletons in there.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
让我们征服这个危险的幽灵洞穴...
消灭里面的邪骸战士。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
The bones are from Skeletons.
Actually Skeletons or just normal bones are all the same but...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
那些骨头来自邪骸战士。
其实邪骸战士和普通骨头没什么区别，但是...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Skeletons are one of the basic undead classes.
Undead never ever. Hunt 15 undead Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
邪骸战士是基础的亡灵类魔物。
亡灵永远不会死亡。去猎杀15只邪骸战士。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
If you feel like you're in danger don't hesitate to just leave.
You're not worried about getting hurt are you?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
如果你觉得危险，不要犹豫，直接离开就好。
你不会担心受伤吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you get how the undead work?
As you know undead never die so, blessing of live person it's same as curse to them.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你明白亡灵的特性了吗？
如你所知，亡灵永远不会死亡，所以活人的祝福对它们来说等同于诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
So... skills which can save people like Heal and Resurrection.
Those things are really strong attacks to undead class.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
所以...像治愈术和复活术这种能拯救人的技能。
对亡灵类魔物来说，这些其实是极强的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Anyway... that's it..
Next... I guess you already see while you were killing Skeletons.
Some green things are picking up all of the stuff dropped by the dead monsters.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
总之...就是这样。
接下来...我想你在杀邪骸战士的时候已经看到了。
有些绿色的东西正在捡起死去的魔物掉落的物品。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Do you know Porings? Maybe they are related to them.
They look really bad, maybe they have been eating poison or something.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你知道波利吗？也许它们和波利有关。
它们看起来状态很差，可能吃了什么毒药之类的东西。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ok if you're ready go and kill those Poporings.
You should hunt 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
好的，如果你准备好了，就去消灭那些变异波利。
你需要猎杀10只。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Skeletons are basic undead.
Use the Heal or Resurrection skill.
If you can.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
邪骸战士是基础亡灵。
使用治愈术或复活术。
如果你会的话。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
以防万一，我会恢复你所有的能量。
这是最后一步，请小心。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you get back what the Poporing stole?
This cave is really deep and there are lots of precious things that they could have picked up.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你拿回被变异波利偷走的东西了吗？
这个洞穴很深，里面有很多它们可能捡走的珍贵物品。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You did really great job. Excellent.
The 1st floor is safer now. Thanks for helping.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你做得非常棒。太出色了。
第一层现在安全多了。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You've completed all of the training missions so go back to the headquarters and get approval from the flashy Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你已完成所有训练任务，所以回到总部，向那位华丽的卢恩骑士申请批准吧。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You might get a new uniform.
Haha. I will keep tabs on your progression.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你可能会得到一套新制服。
哈哈。我会关注你的进步的。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Poporings are stronger than you expect.
If you treat them the same as a normal Poring it will get you in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
变异波利比你想象的更强。
如果你像对待普通波利那样对待它们，会惹上麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
以防万一，我会恢复你所有的能量。
这是最后一步，请小心。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I already informed Boya at the Eden Group headquarters.
If you go there he will give you a big welcome.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
我已经通知乐园团总部的博雅了。
如果你去那里，他会给你盛大的欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You will get a new uniform, aren't you excited?
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
你会得到一套新制服，你不兴奋吗？
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Killing undead?
Do your best to make the world safer.
It's one of the goals of the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔]
消灭亡灵？
尽你所能让世界变得更安全。
这是乐园团的目标之一。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Oops.
You are a member of my group.
Why did you come here, are you looking for danger?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
哎呀。
你是我的组员。
你怎么会来这里，是在寻找危险吗？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
One of the strongest boss monsters is in here.
Be careful when exploring here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
这里有一只非常强大的首领级魔物。
探索这里时要小心。

scripts.text:
[Cloud ]
What are you looking at?
We are not related to each other, are we...
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
你在看什么？
我们之间没有血缘关系，对吧...

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hello?
Why did you come here, looking for danger?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
你好？
你怎么会来这里，是在寻找危险吗？

scripts.text: Conquer Ant Hell
scripts.translation: 征服蚂蚁地狱

scripts.text: Just wanted to meet you
scripts.translation: 只是想见见你

scripts.text: Where am I?
scripts.translation: 我在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Uh. Conquer Ant Hell? Did you say that?
You are a trainee.
You have come to the right place.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
嗯。征服蚂蚁地狱？你是这么说的吗？
你是学员。
你来得正是时候。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
At first I will explain about Ant Hell.
Ants dug a cave in the sand and it is linked to the surface. That's Ant Hell.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
首先我来介绍一下蚂蚁地狱。
蚂蚁在沙地里挖了洞穴，并与地面相连。这就是蚂蚁地狱。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Sand flowed into the hole gradually.
If anyone steps on the hole they will fall into the cave through the hole in the sand..
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
沙子逐渐流进了洞里。
如果有人踩到洞上，就会通过沙地上的洞口掉进洞穴里...

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
It's hard to survive from there.
To us it seems like a normal happening so it isn't a matter of survival like to normal people.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
从那里很难生还。
对我们来说这似乎只是平常发生的事，所以不像普通人那样关乎生死。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Many kinds of ants have come to live here.
There is a boss monster named Maya so you should be more cautious.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
许多种类的蚂蚁都来此居住。
这里有一只名叫蚁后的首领级魔物，所以你要更加小心。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Ok let's try to hunt the weakest ant first.
Pierre is the name of the weakest ant.
They are just down here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
好，我们先试着猎杀最弱的蚂蚁。
最弱的蚂蚁叫白蚁。
它们就在下面。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
In the case of ants, they assist eachother when attacked.
Be careful and kill 15 Pierre ants.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
对于蚂蚁来说，被攻击时会互相帮助。
请小心，猎杀15只白蚁。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
......
Haha... are you joking?
You are exhausted from the extremely hot weather in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
......
哈哈...你在开玩笑吗？
你被沙漠里酷热的天气累坏了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
I am a busy man.
One of the trainees was planning to visit me but that person still hasn't showed yet. I am getting nervous.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
我是个忙碌的人。
有一位学员计划来拜访我，但那个人到现在还没出现。我有点着急了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Where you are?
You are in Anth Hell southwest of Morocc.
Morocc is the closest city, northeast of here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
你在哪里？
你在莫洛克的西南方，蚂蚁地狱。
莫洛克是离这里最近的城市，在东北方。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hey, what was it?
Maybe you saw an Andre when you were hunting Pierre.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
嘿，怎么了？
也许你在猎杀白蚁时看到了变异芯片。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Well, now let's hunt Andre aswel.
Ahah the way you're looking at me, ''why didn't I ask you to do this all at once'' right?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
好吧，现在让我们也猎杀变异芯片。
啊哈，你这样看着我，是觉得“为什么不一开始就让我做这些”对吧？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Ain't it more fun this way?
Hey, now your next target is 15 Andre!
You are strong so it will be fine!
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
这样不是更有趣吗？
嘿，你下一个目标是15只变异芯片！
你很强大，所以没问题的！

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If you can't find Andre go deeper into the cave.
Ah, and be careful of Maya.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
如果找不到白蚁，就往洞穴深处走。
啊，还有，小心蚁后。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
What do you think of Ant Hell?
Can you stay longer?
Ok, I will recover your strengh so, keep going.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
你觉得蚂蚁地狱怎么样？
能坚持更久吗？
好的，我会恢复你的体力，继续加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Great. You seem to have killed all of the Andre.
How do you think about fighting ants?
Was it good?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
很好。看来你已经杀光了所有的白蚁。
你觉得打蚂蚁的感觉如何？
还顺利吗？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hey, cheer up.
To conquer Ant Hell you have one step left.
You might have guessed your next target already.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
嘿，振作一点。
要征服蚂蚁地狱，你只剩最后一步了。
你可能已经猜到下一个目标是谁了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Vitata!
How can I say... He seems like honey.
Pierre is a worker. Andre is a guardian and so... Vitata is like a mother.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
黑蚁！
该怎么说呢...它们就像蜂蜜一样。
工人是Pierre，白蚁是守卫，那么...黑蚁就像是母亲。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
They are really kind to kids and women but don't show any pity to ants.
Hunt the Vitata who takes care of the ant eggs.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
它们对小孩和女性很温柔，但对蚂蚁却毫不留情。
去猎杀那些照顾蚂蚁卵的黑蚁吧。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If somebody falls into Ant Hell it might be a bit safer than before.
Now it's the last step so cheer up and let's kill 10 Vitata.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
如果有人掉进蚂蚁地狱，现在应该比以前安全一点了。
这是最后一步，振作起来，让我们杀掉10只黑蚁。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If you feel you're in too much danger. Just come back.
I will heal you.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
如果你觉得危险太大，就回来吧。
我会治愈你。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
See, to cheer you up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Chin up and cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
看，为了让你振作起来，我会一直治愈你直到你完成训练。
抬起头，振作起来。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Oh... it might have been an anoying fight.
You finished so fast.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
噢...那场战斗可能有点麻烦。
你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Good job. Go back to the headquarters and report.
You've completed the training quickly.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
干得好。回到总部汇报吧。
你很快完成了训练。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
You will get good news.
You did a really good job even under the hot weather.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
你会有好消息的。
即使在炎热的天气下，你也做得非常出色。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
See, to cheer up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Chin up and cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
看，为了让你振作起来，我会一直治愈你直到你完成训练。
抬起头，振作起来。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Just Vitata, isn't that an easy opponent?
If you see Maya just run away.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
只有黑蚁，这不是个简单的对手吗？
如果你看到蚁后，就赶紧逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
It's enough to say that you've conquered Ant Hell.
Aren't you getting used to it here?
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
可以说你已经征服了蚂蚁地狱。
你在这里是不是已经习惯了？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Go back to the headquarters and report that you completed the mission, hurry up
you will receive good news.
You will receive the Eden Group uniform aswel.
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
回到总部汇报你完成了任务，快点。
你会收到好消息的。
你还会收到乐园团的制服。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
I am really proud of the Eden Group.
Does the uniform look good on me?
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[克劳德]
我真的为乐园团感到骄傲。
这制服穿在我身上好看吗？
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Unbelievable why did you come here?
Um... You are not on the third step of the training?
Yeeee~ I'm excited~
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
难以置信，你为什么会来这里？
嗯...你不是在训练的第三步吗？
耶~我好兴奋~

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
I am a little bored waiting for trainees. Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
等学员的时候我有点无聊。他们在哪？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Hello.
Why did you come here?
Umm... Aaaaa...
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你好。
你为什么会来这里？
嗯...啊啊啊...

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Why don't you join my group?
If you have interest in joining us,
you won't regret your decision.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
为什么不加入我的队伍呢？
如果你有兴趣加入我们，
你不会后悔这个决定的。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Hello.
Are you a trainee?
Yeah I can tell.
So shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你好。
你是学员吗？
我看得出来。
那么，我们开始吧？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Actually I don't like this training mission much but anyway let me explain it to you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
其实我不太喜欢这个训练任务，但无论如何，让我给你解释一下。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
As you know this is Orc Village.
Orcs don't like humans.
They don't try to communicate with us. When they see humans they immediately attack us.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你知道的，这里是兽人村。
兽人不喜欢人类。
他们不尝试与我们交流。当他们看到人类时，会立即攻击我们。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Sadly humans don't want to communicate with them either.
So we decided to take a strong approach towards them.
Actually we'd like to get rid of them all.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不幸的是，人类也不想与他们交流。
所以我们决定对他们采取强硬手段。
实际上，我们想消灭他们所有人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
We're trying to conquer Orc Village.
It's the proper place to finish the beginners training mission for an adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
我们正在尝试征服兽人村。
这是像你这般的冒险者完成新手训练任务的合适地点。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
That's why we've chosen this place for this mission.
Ok, we don't have a lot of time so let's begin.
First let's eliminate the weakest one.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
所以我们选择了这个地方作为任务地点。
好吧，我们没有太多时间，让我们开始吧。
首先，让我们消灭最弱的那个。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's better to kill them before they grow up.
Hunt 10 Orc Babies.
Don't pity them because when they grow up they become aggressive Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
最好在它们长大之前杀掉它们。
猎杀10只兽人宝宝。
不要怜悯它们，因为它们长大后就会变成好战的兽人战士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Good or bad this is how it is going to be.
Even if they are babies don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
无论好坏，事情就是这样。
即使是宝宝，也不要犹豫。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Great. Awesome.
It's not very pleasant so let's move on.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
很好。太棒了。
这并不令人愉快，让我们继续吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
On the next step we will fight with Orc Warriors.
When Orc Babies grow up they become strong Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
在下一步，我们将与兽人战士战斗。
当兽人宝宝长大后，它们会变成强大的兽人战士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
They all are powerful warriors.
When you were fighting Orc Babies, you probably have been attacked by them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
它们都是强大的战士。
当你与兽人宝宝战斗时，你可能已经被它们攻击过了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now it's time to hunt 10 Orc Warriors.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
现在是时候猎杀10只兽人战士了。
如果你遇到麻烦，就回到这里安全的地方。
你明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
There are Orc Warriors, Orc Ladies and Orc Babies in Orc Village.
They are really aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
兽人村里有兽人战士、兽人女士和兽人宝宝。
它们真的很有攻击性。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起来很累，我会恢复你的生命值。
如果你遇到麻烦，就回到这里安全的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now you can move on to the next step.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
现在你可以进入下一步了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Exactly... now it's time to hunt Orc Ladies.
If you want to conquer Orc Village completely, you should kill them before they have more Orc Babies.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
没错...现在是时候猎杀兽人女士了。
如果你想完全征服兽人村，你应该在它们生出更多兽人宝宝之前杀掉它们。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
But you don't need to kill all of them.
Go and hunt 10 Orc Ladies.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
但你不需要杀掉它们所有。
去猎杀10只兽人女士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You can already feel the strong power from outside...
Don't hesitate to attack them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你已经能感觉到外面强大的力量了...
不要犹豫攻击它们。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You should be exhausted by now.
But you still have more targets, understand.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你现在应该很疲惫了。
但你还有更多的目标，明白吗。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起来很疲惫，我来帮你恢复体力。
如果遇到危险，随时回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Great job.
Now you should understand how the orc tribe works here in Orc Village.
You've followed the training mission well under hot and humid circumstances.
You have now completed the 'Conquer Orc Village!' training mission. Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
干得不错。
现在你应该了解这里兽人村的运作方式了。
你在炎热潮湿的环境下很好地完成了训练任务。
你已完成“征服兽人村！”训练任务。恭喜。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Go back and report to the Eden Group headquarters.
I'm sure they will have good news for you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
回去向乐园团总部汇报吧。
我相信他们会给你带来好消息。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Orc Lady is the last target.
Cheer up~!
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
兽人女士是最后一个目标。
加油~！

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起来很疲惫，我来帮你恢复体力。
如果遇到危险，随时回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You have completed the training mission.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你已完成训练任务。
回到乐园团总部并在那里汇报。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Have you come here to join in the training?
You look like an expert.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你是来这里参加训练的吗？
你看起来很有经验。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
This isn't a good place to talk so let's hurry.
This place is linked with the dungeon of Orc Village.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这里不适合闲聊，我们快走吧。
这个地方与兽人村的地下城相连。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you see that way.
There is a cave under the ground, normal orcs don't come here.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你能看到那边吗。
地下有一个洞穴，普通的兽人不会来这里。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The safest place is in here.
There are many undead monsters down there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这里是最安全的地方。
下面有很多不死系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The undead monsters are dangerous and threatening.
Don't hesitate when fighting them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不死系魔物危险且具威胁性。
战斗时不要犹豫。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now hunt those undead monsters down there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
现在去猎杀下面那些不死系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Try to hunt 20 Orc zombies in the dungeon.
They are really well organized.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
试着在地下城里猎杀20只兽人腐尸。
它们组织得很严密。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
They will attack you anywhere without hesitating.
May Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
它们会毫不犹豫地攻击你。
愿芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's different from what you saw in Payon, right?
Although you managed to kill the Orc Zombies, you can't be sure you are much stronger..
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这和你在斐扬看到的不同，对吧？
虽然你杀死了兽人腐尸，但你不能确定自己是否真的变强了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
So don't go deeper into that cave or you will die for sure.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
所以不要深入那个洞穴，否则你肯定会死。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The next target is the Orc Skeleton who was walking next to the Orc Zombies.
Hunt 20 Orc Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
下一个目标是走在兽人腐尸旁边的邪骸兽人。
猎杀20只邪骸兽人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's the last step of the training mission in the Orc Dungeon.
It's all up to you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这是兽人地下城训练任务的最后一步。
一切取决于你。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Ok, cheer up and see you again.
Hunt 20 Orc Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
好的，加油，回头见。
猎杀20只邪骸兽人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you stay longer?
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你能再待一会儿吗？
你看起来很疲惫，我来帮你恢复体力。
如果遇到危险，随时回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Your training mission has been completed.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report.
I would like to say more in detail but I'm getting so tired.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你的训练任务已完成。
回到乐园团总部并汇报。
我想说得更详细些，但我太累了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Recently trainees have come here more and more so, I can't sleep at all.
I mean not due to you.
Anyway I will inform the group so go there and report.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
最近学员越来越多，我完全睡不着觉。
当然，这不是你的错。
总之我会通知团里的，你去那边汇报吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you stay longer?
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你能再待一会儿吗？
你看起来很疲惫，我来帮你恢复体力。
如果遇到危险，随时回来这里避难。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Don't you have to report back to the Eden Group headquarters?
I am so tired leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你难道不应该回乐园团总部汇报吗？
我太累了，别打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Uh? What Orc? Explore the dungeon?
You are having such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
啊？什么兽人？探索地下城？
你真是够辛苦的。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
This place is really good to take a rest because Orcs don't come here.
Ho hum...
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
这里很适合休息，因为兽人不会来这里。
呼...

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
You're a trainee for sure.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
你是怎么来到海底城市这么深处的？
啊，那个标志是我们团的。
你肯定是学员吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
What? You aren't?
I... see... I see...
Ok... keep going.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
什么？你不是？
我...明白了...明白了...
好吧...继续前进吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Mysteriously although we're under the sea you can still breathe here.
Do you know why?
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
奇怪的是，虽然我们在海底，但这里依然可以呼吸。
你知道为什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Let's see due to the moisture my skin is so soft.
My fingers and toes are not attached to each other amazing.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
让我看看，因为湿度大，我的皮肤变得很柔软。
我的手指和脚趾都没有连在一起，真神奇。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
I was really shocked and scared when the Eden Group dispatched me here.
Now I love this environment so much.
It's really calm...
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
当初乐园团派我来这里时，我真的又震惊又害怕。
但现在我非常喜欢这里的环境。
这里真的很安静...

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
You're a trainee for sure.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
你是怎么来到海底城市这么深处的？
啊，那个标志是我们团的。
你肯定是学员吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Good to see you!
Alright, look down.
Ancient buildings are sleeping under the water. They were actually built under the sea.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
见到你真好！
好了，往下看。
水下沉睡着一座座古老的建筑。它们其实是在海底建造的。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
As you know we don't have any trouble living here.
But if you see over there... yes right there.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
你知道的，我们在这里生活没有任何困难。
但是如果你看那边...对，就在那里。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Can you see a humanoid fish with a very threatening spear?
He is called a Merman and is a really professional warrior.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
你能看到一个拿着极具威胁性长矛的人形鱼吗？
他被称为人鱼士兵，是一名非常专业的战士。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Okay, go and hunt 15 Merman.
That will be your 1st training mission here.
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
好的，去猎杀15个人鱼士兵。
这将是你在这里的第一个训练任务。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Oh, you came back~!
What did you think of those threatening Mermans?
Actually, I thought that you would chicken out~
scripts.translation:
[卡兰蒂瓦]
哦，你回来了~！
你觉得那些威胁性很强的人鱼士兵怎么样？
其实，我以为你会吓得逃跑~

scripts.text:

啊...现在你看起来不像新手了。

scripts.text:

umm emm..

To.. me.. the hat... um.

看来你不是我们的特工？
有兴趣加入我们吗？

scripts.text:

I wouldn't be surprised if he did

这花了不少时间吧？
铁匠BK说他会强化你的武器。

scripts.text:

远征怎么样？看你的样子，一定很艰难吧。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你从仓库领取必要的装备了吗？
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:

You have to travel very far to get to the ^4d4dffMidgard Expedition Camp^000000!
If you want to stay there then earn your keep by doing missions. Got it?
scripts.translation:

你要去很远的^4d4dff米德加尔特远征营地^000000！
如果你要留在那里，就通过完成任务来证明你的价值。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There are no fees to join!
We are brokers that send help where help is needed. More adventurers like you means more profit.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
加入没有费用！
我们是中介，将援助送往需要的地方。像你这样的冒险者越多，利润就越高。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]

Raim's a good guy.
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
如果你感兴趣，去和莱姆谈谈吧。
莱姆是个好人。
哈哈哈...

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: It's nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

看来我没什么事能帮到你了。

scripts.text:

Well, I'm an instructor for Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
嗯，我是乐园团的指导员。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]

These missions are not very difficult to do.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
我根据你当前的基础等级给你分配任务。
这些任务并不太难。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I am the senior instructor here at Eden Group.
What do you say are you up for the challenge?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
我是乐园团的高级指导员。
你觉得你能接受这个挑战吗？

scripts.text: Not today I'm not.
scripts.translation: 今天不行

scripts.text: Okay, I'll try.
scripts.translation: 好的，我试试

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Really?
That's so sad.
When you finish these missions I will even give you a pretty decent reward.
scripts.translation:

真的吗？
真遗憾。
完成这些任务后，我会给你相当不错的奖励。

scripts.text:

Yeah!
Ok, let me check what mission you should get ok?
scripts.translation:

好，让我看看该给你分配什么任务。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

嗯...我知道你有勇气，但你现在的实力还太弱，帮不上忙。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

好，看来你刚好达到这些任务的最低等级要求。

Yeah, here we go.
scripts.translation:

以你的等级，克魔岛对你来说太简单了。

scripts.text: [Instructor Ur]

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

要是那里没有亡灵魔物肆虐，它本来就会成为卢恩·米德加兹的新首都。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

仔细想想，那地方还挺阴森的。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

I'm sure Romeo gave you some items, but we brought more useful things.
scripts.translation:

罗密欧应该已经给了你一些物品，但我们带来了更有用的东西。

scripts.text:

Go out through that large blue door and walk to the end of the hallway.
Ask the Blacksmith, and he will give you new equipment.
scripts.translation:

穿过那扇巨大的蓝色大门，走到走廊尽头。
问问铁匠，他会给你新的装备。

scripts.text:

Don't forget, I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

All of those undead monsters come from the underground graveyard

scripts.translation:

那些亡灵魔物都来自地下的墓园。
嗯...我想你不需要一直深入到墓园里面去...

scripts.text:

Follow his instructions to help clear out that area.
scripts.translation:

听从他的指示，协助清理那个区域。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
By the way, it looked like Michael had something to tell you as well
Go talk to him, he's at the weapon storage as well.
Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
顺便说一句，看起来迈克尔也有话要对你说。
去和他谈谈，他也在武器仓库。
去吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Also, sometimes Michael needs help, so if you have time try to help him out.
I'm sure he'll reward you for your time.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
另外，迈克尔有时候需要帮忙，如果你有时间的话，试着帮帮他。
我相信他会回报你的时间的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I just realized... this was your first mission, wasn't it?
You must not have gotten the basic equipments yet, right?
Pick them up at the weapon storage.
Ask the Blacksmith Michael and he'll give you the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
我刚才才意识到...这是你的第一个任务，对吧？
你肯定还没拿到基础装备，对吧？
去武器仓库领取。
问问铁匠迈克尔，他会给你装备的。

scripts.text:

Didn't I tell you to go there?
Go there first and then come back to me. Okay?
scripts.translation:

我不是让你去那里吗？
先去那里，然后再回来找我。好吗？

scripts.text:
Hmm.. Not bad ...
You must be getting a hang of this..
Let's go with a simple mission this time
scripts.translation:
嗯...不错...
看来你已经掌握要领了。
这次我们做个简单的任务吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There is a industrial city called Einbroch.
You've heard of it? It's a city clouded with pollution.
You'll appreciate the environment here so much more after visiting that city...
We should all be thankful.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
有一个叫艾音布罗克的工业城市。
你听说过吗？那是一个被污染笼罩的城市。
去过那个城市后，你会更加珍惜这里的环境...
我们都应该心存感激。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Anyways, go out to the field south of Einbroch and you'll see the Dispatched Instructor.
I'm sure he'll recognize you first.
Don't forget to bring the Eden Group badge.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
总之，去艾音布罗克南边的野外，你会看到派遣指导员。
我相信他会先认出你的。
别忘了带上乐园团的徽章。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
The city's pollution is unbearable
But the surrounding fields are relatively clean...
This should be pretty easy for you.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
城市的污染令人难以忍受
但周围的野外相对干净...
这对你来说应该很容易。

scripts.text:
Uh-huh....
Hmm...
You seem like a cool-headed person. What do you think about the ice caves?
scripts.translation:
嗯哼....
嗯...
你看起来是个很冷静的人。你觉得冰洞怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
North of the city of Rachel is a cave filled with ice.
Find the Dispatched Instructor there.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
拉赫城市北边有一个充满冰的洞穴。
在那里找到派遣指导员。

scripts.text:
Well, well...
I don't even know where to send you now.
I'm sure you are familiar with most places around here
scripts.translation:
哎呀...
我现在都不知道该派你去哪了。
我想你对这里的大部分地区都很熟悉吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Then, should I send you somewhere farther this time?
There is a Cat Paw Agent here.
Do you see him over there?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
那么，这次我应该把你派到更远的地方吗？
这里有一位猫爪特工。
你看到那边那个人了吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Through him, you can get to Ash Vacuum pretty easily .
Since there is a Expedition Camp there...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
通过他，你可以很容易地到达阿什真空。
因为那里有一个远征营地...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
All you have to do is find the Eden Group agent there.
Tell him I sent you, and he'll give you instructions.
You can explore the new world
It's like a vacation isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
你只需要找到那里的乐园团特工。
告诉他是我派你来的，他会给你指示。
你可以探索新世界
这就像度假一样，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hahaha!
.. Maybe I'll go instead of sending you.
Anyways, their names are Ma~ something... I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
哈哈哈！
...也许我会代替你去。
总之，他们的名字是Ma~什么...我不记得了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]

Isn't this the easiest mission you've ever had?
Don't forget my present when you come back~!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 乌尔]
那么，任务再次是找到米德加尔特远征营地的特工。
这难道不是你做过最轻松的任务吗？
回来时别忘了我的礼物哦~！

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
How are you?
Comodo has the best weather in the whole world.
Even during the winter, Comodo has great weather.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
你好吗？
克魔岛拥有全世界最好的天气。
即使在冬天，克魔岛的气候也很宜人。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
How are you?
You were sent here by Instructor Ur right?
Did you come here for a quest?
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
你好吗？
你是被指导员 乌尔派来的，对吧？
你是来做任务的吗？

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
So, how good of an explorer are you now?
You've fought these before, so clearing this cave should be possible.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
那么，你现在作为探险者有多厉害呢？
既然你之前打过这些怪物，清理这个洞穴应该没问题。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
As a test of the difficulty of this cave
Go defeat 3 Stalactic Golems.
Watch out for other monsters as well.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
为了测试这个洞穴的难度，
去击败3只钟乳巨石怪。
也要小心其他魔物。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
You must go through this cave to the outside.
Don't forget to defeat the Stalactic Golems you run into on the way.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
你必须穿过这个洞穴到外面去。
别忘了击败路上遇到的钟乳巨石怪。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I always give the same test to the trainees that come here..
I've never seen anyone pass it so perfectly like you did.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
我对来这里的学员总是进行同样的测试...
我从未见过有人像你这样完美地通过。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Do you know why?
Comodo is surrounded by the ocean and caves.
Seasonal changes don't make any difference in the temperature here.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
你知道为什么吗？
克魔岛被海洋和洞穴环绕。
季节变化对这里的气温没有任何影响。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Take it easy here.
This area is a place for relaxation.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
在这里放松一下。
这个地方是供人休憩的。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I don't know if this will fit you well
Why don't you just try it.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
我不确定这是否适合你，
为什么不试试看呢。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
The thing about this cave is that, many monsters are created from stones.
If you stay cautious, they shouldn't be too threatning...
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
关于这个洞穴，很多魔物是由石头构成的。
如果你保持警惕，它们应该不太有威胁...

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
But most of them have range attacks..
And sometimes a really strong one roams around.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
但大多数都有远程攻击...
而且有时会有非常强大的个体在周围游荡。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Well... this is the reason why you train right?
Let's try taking on one of the big monsters
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
嗯...这就是你训练的原因，对吧？
让我们试着挑战一只大型魔物。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
'They are called 'Stalactic Golem'.
Try defeating some of them.
Not too difficult, right?
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
它们被称为“钟乳巨石怪”。
试着击败几只。
不难，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
As I said before, since Komodo is a city inside a cave..
Access to the outside world is mostly done through the east entrance, but...
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
正如我之前所说，因为克魔岛是洞穴内的城市...
通往外界主要依靠东入口，但是...

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Let's try going out through the north.
There should be things you can hunt out there.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
让我们试着从北边出去。
外面应该有一些可以狩猎的东西。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
And instead of just walking out,
Let's kill about 10 Stalactic Golems on the way out.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
而且不要只是走出去，
让我们在出去的路上击败大约10只钟乳巨石怪。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
So that, travelers coming from the north can safely walk through.
Remember, 10 Stalactic Golems. Then come to the other side of northern part of the cave
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
这样，从北方来的旅行者就能安全通过了。
记住，10只钟乳巨石怪。然后到洞穴北部的另一边来找我。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I'll be waiting outside.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
我会在外面等你。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Let me help you recover if you are tired.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
如果你累了，让我帮你恢复一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Ah, I see you didn't get lost.
Your skills at defeating those Stalactic Golems were better than I expected.
Just means you've improved that much.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
啊，看来你没有迷路。
你击败那些钟乳巨石怪的技巧比我预期的要好。
看来你进步了不少。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I see you didn't get lost.
But you didn't defeat enough Stalactic Golems..
Go back and defeat them.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
看来你没有迷路。
但你击败的钟乳巨石怪还不够...
回去继续击败它们。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
You really got these by defeating the monsters?
I believe you. I want to get out of here anyways.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
这些真的是你击败魔物后获得的吗？
我相信你。反正我也想离开这里了。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Didn't I already tell you the last task?
Defeat the monsters in this forest, and bring me the items I asked for.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
我不是已经告诉过你最后一个任务了吗？
击败这片森林里的魔物，并带给我我要求的物品。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
If you were sent from the Eden Group for training, wait for me at the town.
I'm waiting for a different trainee right now.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
如果你是受乐园团派遣来训练的，请在城镇等我。
我现在正在等另一位学员。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
No no.. Not here.
I'm waiting for a different trainee right now.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
不不...不是在这里。
我现在正在等另一位学员。
请回去。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Ugh, It's way too hot here.
You can leave now.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
唉，这里太热了。
你可以离开了。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Now look around here
We're in a dense forest now.
There are Dryads and Wootans here...
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
现在看看四周。
我们现在身处茂密的森林中。
这里有森林妖姬和伍坦战士...

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Next task is to clearing this area of monsters.
Bring me the following from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
下一个任务是清理这片区域的魔物。
请从魔物身上收集以下物品。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
5 Wootan Fighter's Shoulderguard
7 Dryad's Sharp Leaf
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
5个伍坦战士护肩
7片尖锐的叶子

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
This is the last test.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
这是最后的测试。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I'll help you recover if you are tired.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
如果你累了，我会帮你恢复状态。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
There are no more training tasks here.
Go back and report to Ur.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
这里没有更多的训练任务了。
回去向乌尔汇报吧。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
5 Wootan Fighter's Shoulderguard
7 Dryad's Sharp Leaf
You must bring me those to pass this test.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
5个伍坦战士护肩
7片尖锐的叶子
你必须带给我这些才能通过测试。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I'll help you recover if you are tired.
scripts.translation:
[罗密欧]
如果你累了，我会帮你恢复状态。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Ah~ So bored.
You're not the one Ur sent, are you?
Oh~ That's okay.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
啊~真无聊。
你不是乌尔派来的人，对吧？
哦~没关系。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Oh oh!!
You're finally here!
I asked Ur to send someone to help me here!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
哦哦！！
你终于来了！
我让乌尔派人来帮我！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Oh~ You are pretty strong!
I'm so glad that someone strong like you came.
I wouldn't have last long here by myself.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
哦~你很强啊！
很高兴像这样强大的人来了。
如果只有我一个人，我可能撑不了多久。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
...Oh you're back!
(Johan Opens the door and checks)
....!
Okay!!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
...哦，你回来了！
(约翰打开门查看)
....!
好的！！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Ugh, I still haven't found the thing I lost.
Hmm... I may need to wait for the next trainee before I can start looking again... Eep!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
唉，我还是没找到我丢的东西。
嗯...我可能得等下一位学员来了才能重新开始找...哎呀！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
20 Wraiths!
I'll watch your back!.
... Of.. Course.. I'll fight too!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
20只恶灵！
我会掩护你的！
...当...当然...我也会战斗！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
10 Evil Druids!
I'll watch your back, like last time.
... Of... Course... I'll fight them too!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
10只暗神官！
我会像上次一样掩护你的。
...当...当然...我也会一起战斗！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Go back and report to Ur.
That Glast Heim Abbey is clear now.
I need to stay and look for something... Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
回去向乌尔汇报吧。
格拉斯特海姆修道院已经清理干净了。
我需要留下来找点东西...再见。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
This is Glast Heim Abbey.
Be careful, there are a lot of lost souls around here.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
这里是格拉斯特海姆修道院。
小心点，这里有很多迷失的灵魂。

scripts.text: What? I came for training..
scripts.translation: 什么？我是来接受训练的...

scripts.text:
[Johan]
No no, that's the same thing!
Your training mission is to help me clear out this Abbey!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
不不，这也是一样的！
你的训练任务就是帮我清理这座修道院！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Phew... It's been so tough.
I can't run in by myself, but then Gargoyles attack me out here..
Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
呼...真是够呛。
我一个人不敢进去，但在这里外面又会被蝙蝠弓箭手攻击..
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Johan]
This abbey is our responsibilty.
Just like other monasteries, this one has an underground graveryad as well, but..
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
这座修道院是我们的责任。
和其他修道院一样，这里也有地下墓园，但是..

scripts.text:
[Johan]
As you well know, this castle... is not at a normal state.
I think that's causing these souls from being able to rest in peace.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
你也知道，这座城堡...并不正常。
我想这就是导致这些灵魂无法安息的原因。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Let's defeat the ones around here first, since going underground may be too much for just us.
I'll be testing how skilled you are as well...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
让我们先解决这里周围的魔物吧，毕竟只有我们两个人，去地下可能有点吃力。
我也会顺便测试一下你的实力...

scripts.text:
[Johan]
First target are the Wraiths.
You can tell them apart by their strange laugh.
They look like demons, but we can't tell for sure...
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
第一个目标是恶灵。
你可以通过它们奇怪的怪笑来分辨它们。
它们看起来像恶魔，但我们无法确定...

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Defeat 20 Wraiths.
I'll assist you from here!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
击败20只恶灵。
我会在这里协助你！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
By the way, did you see those other monsters besides the Wraiths?
They are the corrupted souls of priests.
They are called 'Evil Druid' as well.
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
顺便问一下，除了恶灵，你看到其他魔物了吗？
它们是堕落牧师的灵魂。
它们也被称为“暗神官”。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Let's take care of these Evil Druids this time.
10 of them.
You can do it right?
I believe in you!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
这次让我们来清理这些暗神官吧。
一共10只。
你能做到的，对吧？
我相信你！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Thank you! I really appreciate it!
I think I can enter without any worries now!
I hope those evil souls left it alone..
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
谢谢你！我真的非常感谢！
我想我现在可以放心进去了！
希望那些邪恶的灵魂不会打扰我..

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Hehe, I'll put in a good word to Ur!
You're a valient and skilled exorcist!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
嘿嘿，我会向乌尔好好夸夸你的！
你是一位勇敢且技艺高超的驱魔师！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
You can go back to Eden now
I'll stay and clean up the rest, hehe
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
你可以回伊甸了。
我会留下来清理剩下的，嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Uh... You didn't hear that did you?
Hahahahahahaha!!!
Hahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[约翰]
呃...你没听到刚才的话吧？
哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What?
....
Hmm, Ur sent you?
Oh, that training mission thing.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
什么？
....
嗯，是乌尔派你来的？
哦，那个训练任务的事。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What, You're done already?
I was just about to fall asleep... Oh well..
It can't be helped, I guess. Let's go to a different spot..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
什么，你已经完成了？
我刚才差点睡着了...算了..
没办法，我想。我们去别的地方吧..

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
So, have you punished those Porcellio's yet?
I don't think you're done yet right?
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
那么，你惩罚那些三叶铁甲虫了吗？
我觉得你还没做完吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Um...
I'm getting it done.
Hmm...
I'm still tired to finish...
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
嗯...
我正在处理。
嗯...
还是太累了，做不完...

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
The monsters are at the northern fields of Einbroch.
Find the Noxious...
Don't try to lie to me that you've finished hunting them.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
魔物在艾音布罗克的北方田野。
去找废气魔...
别想骗我说你已经把它们都打完了。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm not a thief...
It's a hard living.
Nor is there any real ambition.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
我不是盗贼...
生活很艰难。
也没什么真正的抱负。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What are you looking at?
You want something from me?
Mind your own business, go away..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
你看什么？
想从我这里得到什么？
管好你自己的事，走吧。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What serious?
Have you made your report to Instructor Ur?
Einbroch has commissioned work out so that means more training.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
什么严重？
你向指导员 乌尔汇报了吗？
艾音布罗克有委托工作，这意味着更多的训练。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
You've came a long way, I won't make you do anything too tough, don't worry.
The fields outside of Einbroch isn't too bad.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
你走了这么远的路，我不会让你做太累的事，别担心。
艾音布罗克外面的田野情况还不错。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
And monsters here usually leaves me alone, so I can nap all day.
But there are some that bother me.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
这里的魔物通常不会打扰我，所以我可以整天睡觉。
但有些会来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Do you know Porcellios are?
Ugly looking insects... They steal too..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
你知道三叶铁甲虫吗？
长得很难看的虫子...它们还会偷东西。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Let's defeat some of them as a warm up.
There are plenty of them around here. 30 shouldn't be too hard right?
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
让我们先打几只热热身。
这里有很多。30只应该不难吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm not holding a grudge just because they ate my lunch.
I'll be resting here until you're done.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
我没记仇，虽然它们吃了我的午餐。
我会在这里休息，直到你完成。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
No, what are you talking about?
Go... with you?
You can by yourself right?
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
不，你在说什么？
去...和你一起？
你自己能行吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Okay, next task!
People of Einbroch say that the pollution is really bad in the north.
They are worried that pollution will drift into the town.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
好的，下一个任务！
艾音布罗克的人说北边的污染很严重。
他们担心污染会飘进城镇。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
It's probably all those factories right there...
I guess I should still look into it.
The cause for the pollution... Find it and destroy it.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
大概是那边的那些工厂...
我想我还是应该调查一下。
找到污染的原因...并摧毁它。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
30 Venomous and 5 Teddy Bears.
That should be good enough.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
30只毒液魔和5只泰迪熊。
这样就够了。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm sure you'll do fine without me watching.
To show my support, let me give you some EXP and HP recovery.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
我相信没有我盯着你也能做好。
为了表示支持，让我给你一些经验和HP恢复。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
The monsters are at the northern fields of Einbroch.
Okay then, be safe.
I'm going to take a nap.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
魔物在艾音布罗克的北方田野。
那么，注意安全。
我要去睡个觉。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
If you're hurt I'll heal you a bit.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
如果你受伤了，我会给你一点治愈术。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Good. Those monsters have been bothering the Einbroch workers.
That was great..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
很好。那些魔物一直在骚扰艾音布罗克的工人。
做得不错。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I have some things to report to Instructor Ur.
I've been watching you closely and you've done well. Go back to Ur and deliver this report.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
我有一些事要向指导员 乌尔汇报。
我一直在密切关注你，你做得很好。回去把这份报告交给乌尔。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Yeah, if this is okay?
Ugh this is difficult.
I'll make you feel better though.
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
嗯，如果这样没问题？
唉，这很难。
不过我会让你感觉好一点的。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Come practitioners?
Make things.
How convenient witchinya.
Heumnya. I'll sleep in one breath..
scripts.translation:
[基伦]
来实践的人？
制造东西。
真是方便啊。
呼...我要一口气睡过去了。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
It's more than that~
Now where did the time go~
I thought you said you sent me~!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
不止这些哦~
时间都去哪儿了~
我还以为你把我派出去了呢~！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Ah... It's over...
Good!
Your skills have been verified.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
啊...结束了...
很好！
你的技能已经得到验证了。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
The biggest stumbling block is dealing with the Siromas.
Have you hunted 30 yet?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
最大的障碍是处理小雪怪。
你打满30只了吗？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Ohh!
You've brought everything.
Okay, so just one last thing...!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
哦！
你带齐了所有东西。
好的，最后还有一件事...！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Have you finished hunting the 30 Siroma yet?
You've already done it once so this shouldn't be difficult...
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
你打完那30只小雪怪了吗？
你之前已经做过一次了，这次应该不难...

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Were you there yet?
Other people have come and go since you've been here last.
Now I don't have to get the materials myself.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
你终于来了？
你上次离开后，这里人来人往。
现在我不必自己去收集材料了。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Alas, is there anywhere where the buildup of ice caps is more than here?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
唉，还有哪里比这里堆积更多的冰块吗？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
What is it? You'll help me. Is that right?
No, you don't have to do that.
I'm waiting for someone scheduled to help me.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
怎么了？你会帮我的，对吧？
不，你不必这样做。
我在等一个预定来帮我的人。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And you are?
Oh, you were sent here by Ur?
I don't know how long I've been waiting here in the snow.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
你是？
哦，你是乌尔派来的？
我不知道我在雪地里等了多久了。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
This is the ice dungeon of the northern plains.
Nothing like a cave that's cold the entire year.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
这是北方平原的冰窟。
不像那种终年寒冷的洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
So this is where the people of Rachel go for their ice supply.
But, this area is crawling with dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
所以这就是拉赫的人们获取冰块的地方。
但是，这个区域爬满了危险的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
One of those monsters is known as a Siroma.
They should be a good challenge for you.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
其中一种魔物被称为小雪怪。
它们应该对你来说是个不错的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Okay, then go in the cave and find those Siroma.
It's cold in there but this job has to be done.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
好了，进去洞穴里找那些小雪怪。
里面很冷，但这项工作必须完成。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
OH, sometimes
You be careful in there.
Well, good luck~!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
哦，有时候
你在里面要小心。
嗯，祝你好运~！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Now, what have I happened to do next.
Those Siromas seem to be growing at a faster rate.
As before go and hunt 30 more Siromas and bring me some materials.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
现在，我接下来该做什么。
那些小雪怪似乎繁殖得更快了。
像之前一样，再去打30只小雪怪，给我带些材料来。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And get this... Well...
Please listen carefully
30 Ice Cubic
1 Sweet Sauce
1 Milk
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
还有这个...嗯...
请仔细听好
30 冰块一角
1 甜酱汁
1 牛奶

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I'm not just doing this for myself you know.
I'm doing this for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
我这么做不仅仅是为了我自己。
我是为了大家。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
That's the last of it anyways.
So hunt those Siromas and get the materials.
We understand each other?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
反正这就是最后的要求了。
所以去打那些小雪怪，收集材料。
我们达成共识了？

scripts.text: What about you?
scripts.translation: 那你呢？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Me? Well of course... I'm going to stand guard here.
I... I'm a busy person!
Besides this is training so who are you to ask me what about me?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
我？那当然是...我要在这里站岗。
我...我很忙的！
而且这是训练，你凭什么问我“那你呢”？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Go now!
Those Siromas are going to just get rowdier by the minute.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
快去吧！
那些小雪怪只会越来越暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Oh, you want help recovering your HP/SP huh?
You'll get nothing from me~!
What challenge would that be if I did that?
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
哦，你想让我帮你恢复HP/SP吗？
没门~！
那样还有什么挑战性呢？

scripts.text: ...... Look

[Naomi]
Yes, yes? Why not?
...
Oh, that's right! I'm supposed to give you something.
You've done enough, I know.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
是的，是的？为什么不呢？
...
啊，对了！我本该给你点东西的。
你已经做得够多了，我知道。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I'll inform Instructor Ur.
A few more stages left to go so don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
我会向指导员 乌尔汇报的。
还有几个阶段，别担心！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Oh and congratulations!
This is the last training stage prepared!
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
哦，恭喜！
这是最后一个训练阶段了！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I guess I should do some of this myself~
Muahaha~
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
看来我也该亲自做点这种事了~
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And don't forget the 30 Ice Cubic, 1 Sweet Sauce, and 1 Milk.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
别忘了那30个冰块一角、1份甜酱汁和1瓶牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Report back to Instructor Ur and report that the job is done.
Don't procrastinate.
scripts.translation:
[娜奥米]
回去向指导员 乌尔汇报任务完成。
别拖延。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
The proof that you have there.
You're here in paradise.
Instructor Ur sent you?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你手里拿着证明。
你身处乐园。
是指导员 乌尔派你来的？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
So what's up?!
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
那么，有什么事吗？！

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Well, whatever the Nepenthes and Pinguicula proof has been collected.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
嗯，猪笼草和捕虫堇的证明已经收集好了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Oh, sorry.
I don't know much about the life of an adventurer.
I'm just a member of Eden Group...
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
哦，抱歉。
我不太了解冒险者的生活。
我只是乐园团的一员...

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Can you find those two brothers?
Find out what's up with them.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你能找到那两兄弟吗？
查清楚他们那边发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
........
Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Oh, my mistake.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
哦，我的失误。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
How do you do?
Oh, so you're here for the training from Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你好。
哦，你是来接受指导员 乌尔的训练的。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Ok, I'm in a bit of a situation right now so I asked Instructor Ur to use his missions to help.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
好的，我现在有点状况，所以我请指导员 乌尔用他的任务来帮忙。

scripts.text: A situation?
scripts.translation: 状况？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Yes, 
Find Mine and do what he asks you.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
是的，
去找米内，然后照他说的做。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
We dispatched him to do something and he hasn't done it yet so I'm guessing he's either chickened out or failed.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
我们派他去执行任务，但他还没完成，所以我猜他要么是胆小退缩了，要么是搞砸了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
So can you find him out there in Splendide Field?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
所以你能去辉煌领域野外找到他吗？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Find him and figure out what the heck he's up to please.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
找到他，弄清楚他到底在搞什么鬼。

scripts.text: - You tell her about Meeru and Mine. -
scripts.translation: - 你告诉她关于米鲁和米内的事。 -

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Yeah? Oh what?
This is not really...
Ok I'll go deal with them.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
是吗？哦，什么？
这其实不算...
好吧，我去处理他们。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Well, whatever the Nepenthes and Pinguicula proof has been collected.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
嗯，猪笼草和捕虫堇的证明已经收集好了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Your training is done so go back and talk to Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你的训练结束了，回去找指导员 乌尔吧。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Your training is done so go back and talk to Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特]
你的训练结束了，回去找指导员 乌尔吧。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
You think I'll lose!
...?
All of them... Who're you?!
Mine is a stooge?
He sent you to watch me!?
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
你以为我会输！
...？
你们所有人...你是谁？！
米内是个跟班？
他派你来监视我！？

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Hmm yes I saw.
I knew I should've asked you to hunt more than 1.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
嗯，是的，我看到了。
我早知道该让你多抓一只的。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Is hunting the Nepenthes too much for you?
You seem a bit flushed.
Fine I'll heal you!
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
抓猪笼草对你来说太难了吗？
你看起来有点脸红。
好吧，我来治愈你！

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
I'll just be here making sure other people hunt the Nepenthes. I might ask them to hunt more than 1 who knows.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
我就在这里看着别人抓猪笼草。我可能会让他们多抓一只，谁知道呢。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Something wrong?
Did you have trouble with that Nepenthes...
.........hyuk huk.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
怎么了？
你抓那只猪笼草有困难吗...
.........呼 呼。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
What? Isn't that it?
... ...
Mine didn't send you did he?
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
什么？不是这样吗？
... ...
米内没派你来的吧？

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
What? Isn't that it?
... ...
Mine didn't send you did he?
So why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
什么？不是这样吗？
... ...
米内没派你来的吧？
那你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: Margaret sent me
scripts.translation: 玛格丽特派我来的

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Ah, Margaret!
Mine and Margaret are always trying to mess with me because of my win-!
Gosh...
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
啊，玛格丽特！
米内和玛格丽特总是因为我的胜利而...
真是的...

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text: What do you win?
scripts.translation: 你赢了什么？

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
It all started with them bickering.
Margaret was asked to scout for both of us. It's like what you're doing now.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
一切都始于他们的争吵。
玛格丽特被要求为我们双方侦察。就像你现在做的一样。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Mine said that he was strong enough to defeat any monster.
So I insisted that he go to either East or West of the camp and show me.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
米内说他足够强大，能击败任何魔物。
所以我坚持让他去营地东边或西边，向我证明一下。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Mine made an idle threat and huffed and puffed but didn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
米内只是虚张声势，吹嘘了一番，但什么也没做。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Basically, Margaret didn't believe him and challenged him to kill 1 Nepenthes.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
基本上，玛格丽特不相信他，于是挑战他去杀1只猪笼草。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
So anyways now I'm charged with asking people to go and hunt 1 Nepenthes because of that bickering incident.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
所以，因为那次争吵，我现在被指派去让人去猎杀1只猪笼草。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
It's really not that difficult to hunt 1 so just go to the field East of here and kill one of them.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
猎杀1只其实并不难，只要去这里东边的田野，杀掉其中一只就行了。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Anyways you've proven that you're stronger than Mine ever made himself out to be.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
总之，你已经证明了自己比米内吹嘘的要强得多。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Well anyways here's a small reward.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
好了，这是一点小小的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
I'll just be here making sure other people hunt the Nepenthes. I might ask them to hunt more than 1 who knows.
scripts.translation:
[米鲁]
我就在这里看着别人抓猪笼草。我可能会让他们多抓一只，谁知道呢。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh cruel world...
...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
残酷的世界啊...
...
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Excellent!
Now I can go back to the camp and...
scripts.translation:
[米内]
太好了！
现在我可以回营地...

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Come on 5 Pinguicula.
Really how did you get here then?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
拜托了，5只捕虫堇。
真是的，你是怎么跑到这里来的？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh cruel world.
...
Way to go passing by.
What a fiasco this has turned out to be
scripts.translation:
[米内]
残酷的世界啊。
...
真是白跑一趟。
这简直是一场闹剧。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Margaret gets everything she wants back at the camp.
Don't you worry, I'm going back soon.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
玛格丽特在营地拿到了她想要的一切。
别担心，我很快就会回去的。

scripts.text: Margaret sent me.
scripts.translation: 玛格丽特派我来的。

scripts.text: Yeah I'm here...
scripts.translation: 对，我来了...

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Eh? Who!
I see. Is it that time already?
This has been difficult.
I'm in a crisis here!
scripts.translation:
[米内]
诶？谁啊？
原来如此。已经到那个时间了吗？
这真让人头疼。
我现在陷入困境了！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh so you're not here by your own will eh?
So why even bother coming?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
哦，原来你不是自愿来的啊？
那何必大老远跑一趟呢？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
You didn't want to be here right?
Margaret sent you instead of someone else I bet.
Whatever, anyway I'm in a crisis here!
scripts.translation:
[米内]
你本来就不想来对吧？
我猜玛格丽特派你来而不是别人。算了，反正我现在陷入困境了！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok I don't want to admit it but you gotta help me out here.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
好吧，我不想承认，但你得帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok just because I was complaining doesn't mean they have to send me here!
scripts.translation:
[米内]
好吧，我只是抱怨了一下，他们没必要把我派到这里来！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I mean they've asked for too much of a simple person like myself.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
我是说，他们对我这种普通人要求太多了。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok here's the deal.
I'm supposed to hunt those Pinguiculas. Just 5 of 'em.
But you'll do that for me yeah?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
好吧，事情是这样的。
我本该去猎杀那些捕虫堇，只要5只。
但你会替我做的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I promise you I'll give you something good.
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
我保证会给你不错的回报。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I mean, can you tell Margaret that it's all done?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
我是说，你能告诉玛格丽特事情都办完了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh don't worry she won't mind. I'll just go back to doing what I was doing. Here's your reward.
scripts.translation:
[米内]
哦，别担心，她不会介意的。我会回去继续做我原本在做的事。这是给你的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
You're not lying about being a real adventurer are you?
scripts.translation:
[米内]
你该不会是在撒谎，假装自己是真正的冒险者吧？

scripts.text: - You have too many items in your inventory to continue -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续 -

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm, are you a member of Eden Group?
You need to be one of our members to use my services.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，你是乐园团的成员吗？
你需要成为我们的成员才能使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
怎么了？

scripts.text: Strengthen Equipment
scripts.translation: 强化装备

scripts.text: Personal Request
scripts.translation: 个人委托

scripts.text: Give me new equipment.
scripts.translation: 给我新装备

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm equipment strengthening.
I don't exactly do that for just anyone.
The first step is at least a higher degree of training so have you done the Eden Group training yet?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，装备强化。
我并不是对谁都做这件事的。
第一步至少需要更高的训练等级，你做过乐园团的训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Strengthen your equipment eh?
I'll strengthen the new Eden Group equipment for you by giving it a random stat boost.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
强化装备是吧？
我会通过随机提升属性来为你强化新的乐园团装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I will strengthen your equipment after you've done a personal request of mine.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
在你完成我的个人委托后，我会为你强化装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Have you started the request of Instructor Ur?
I'm lending my services to those who are worthy.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你开始指导员乌尔的委托了吗？
我只为那些值得的人提供服务。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Glad you're here.
As a blacksmith I am in need of Iron materials constantly.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
很高兴你来了。
作为一名铁匠，我始终需要铁材。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Let me guess...
You've brought me the best quality materials.
Good.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
让我猜猜...
你带给我的是最高品质的材料。
很好。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Now, that's it.
That's enough for today.
For now, ask me to strengthen your equipment and I'll do it for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
好了，就这样。
今天够了。
现在，让我为你强化装备吧，我会照做的。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Come back later.
You have to wait for some time first.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
稍后再来。
你必须先等待一段时间。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Uh-huh...
What are we going to... oh don't worry.
Come to me later.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯嗯...
我们要做什么...哦，别担心。
稍后来找我。

scripts.text: [Thorn]
scripts.translation: [索恩]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Okay, I'll give you equipment.
I'll give you good armor and equipment that you'll be proud of.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
好的，我会给你装备。
我会给你优质的盔甲和装备，让你引以为傲。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You can strengthen the equipment that I gave you.
Weapons Expert BK is at Eden Group Headquarters and he can do that for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你可以强化我给你的装备。
武器专家BK在乐园团总部，他可以为你做这件事。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Have you gotten your gear yet?
I can give you the gear but I can't strengthen it for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你拿到装备了吗？
我可以给你装备，但我不能为你强化它。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I'm not permitted to do this by Instructor Ur.
Don't mess with me.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
指导员乌尔不允许我这样做。
别跟我耍花样。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You have not awakened yet.
First do the missions set forth by Instructor Ur and I'll help you strengthen your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你还没有觉醒。
先完成指导员乌尔布置的任务，然后我会帮你强化装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I won't help you unless you do that first!
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
除非你先完成那些任务，否则我不会帮你！

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
So what equipment do you want to enhance?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
那么，你想强化什么装备？

scripts.text: Eden Group Manteau II
scripts.translation: 乐园团斗篷

scripts.text: Eden Group Armor IV
scripts.translation: 乐园团 制服 Ⅳ

scripts.text: Eden Group Boots IV
scripts.translation: 乐园团短靴 Ⅳ

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I just want to be sure that you're worthy of using my services.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我只是想确认你有资格使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Besides, you won't have the equipment that I can enhance until you do those missions.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
而且，在你完成那些任务之前，你还没有我可以强化的装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Of course there will be a reward eventually...
So...
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
当然，最终会有奖励...
所以...

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Bring me some materials.
I need 20 Iron Ore, and 10 Iron.
It shouldn't be hard to get these can you bring them right away?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
带些材料给我。
我需要20个铁矿石和10个铁。
这些应该不难找，你能马上带来吗？

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Bring me some materials.
Bring 20 Used Iron Plate.
It shouldn't be hard to get these can you bring them right away?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
带些材料给我。
带20个老旧的铁板。
这些应该不难找，你能马上带来吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 我不想。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I appreciate it.
So take your time and I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我很感激。
那你慢慢来，我会等着。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Eh...?
Guess you're too busy to help me.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
呃...？
看来你太忙了，没法帮我。

scripts.text: [Thorn]
scripts.translation: [索恩]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I can always use more Iron materials.
Instead of a normal reward I'll give you an advanced equipment.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我总可以用更多的铁材料。
作为奖励，我会给你一件高级装备，而不是普通的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
If at any time you think you have equipment that you need to strengthen come by me again.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
如果你任何时候觉得有需要强化的装备，随时再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
If you have one of these bring them to me.
Eden Group Manteau II, Eden Group Armor IV, Eden Group Boots IV.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
如果你有以下物品，请带给我。
乐园团斗篷 Ⅱ、乐园团 制服 Ⅳ、乐园团短靴 Ⅳ。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
So now, ^4d4dffmake sure that you have enough free inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
那么现在，^4d4dff请确保你有足够的空闲背包空间。^000000

scripts.text: Let me organize my inventory.
scripts.translation: 让我整理一下背包

scripts.text: I have free space.
scripts.translation: 我有空闲空间

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You do that.
Free up your inventory so that you can get the weapons, boots, and all the other equipment.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
去吧。
腾出背包空间，以便领取武器、靴子和其他所有装备。

scripts.text: [Thorn]
scripts.translation: [索恩]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm, you are eligible to receive equipment.
Yeah I understand that.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，你有资格领取装备。
我明白。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Here's your equipment.
I'll also give you the other gear that comes along with this set.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
这是你的装备。
我会把这套装备附带的其他装备也一并给你。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm something went wrong though. I'm not sure what...
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，好像出了点问题。我不确定是什么...

scripts.text:
Here's your equipment.
I'll also give you the other gear that comes along with this set.
scripts.translation:
这是你的装备。
我会把这套装备附带的其他装备也一并给你。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
So go to him and he can make your equipment stronger.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
所以去找他，他可以帮你强化装备。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Your armor can be strengthened by someone else.
I wish I could but I can't.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你的防具可以由别人来强化。
我很想帮你，但我做不到。

scripts.text: [Toren]
scripts.translation: [托伦]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Eden Group {0}?
I understand.
Remember the stats that are enhanced will be random.
You sure you want me to enhance this?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
乐园团 {0}？
我明白了。
请记住，强化的属性是随机的。
你确定要我强化这个吗？

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm... Don't you have the {0}?
I don't think you have it with you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯...你没有 {0} 吗？
我觉得你身上没有带。

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了

scripts.text: Yes, enhance it.
scripts.translation: 是的，强化它

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You sure you don't want to enhance it?
It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你确定不想强化它吗？
这是你的选择。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I understand.
Let's begin the enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我明白了。
让我们开始强化吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm... Don't you have the {0}?
